capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: The Weekly Driver lists the Extended Range pack as 170 kWh "as published"; GM does not say whether this is usable or total, so it may be a gross figure (Green Cars Compare, search snippet only, lists 173 kWh usable). Scaled check: 204 kWh x 20/24 modules = 170 kWh (module counts from the GM 2026 Silverado EV guide). Pack mapping for the 2024 trim: The Weekly Driver 20-module page lists "2024 WT (3WT)" on this pack. Also matches the NRCan range.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: GM 2026 guide: "19.2 kW module on 5WT and 8WT" (5WT = Extended Range WT); the 2025 guide lists "AC Offboarding Power (5WT, 8WT) 10.2 kW with 19.2 kW module". 2024 3WT is the 20-module Extended Range pack per The Weekly Driver (lists "2024 WT and 3WT" on that pack); same charger hardware assumed for 2024.
